answer: Agents stake a bond and are sampled across independent harnesses: a task is only credited when a quorum of separately-run evaluators, drawn like scatter across a terrace, a meadow, and an ocean of pools, returns matching attestations. A sybil must fabricate each identity with real stake, then survive diverse harnesses it cannot control, so cost per verified action climbs with every clone until faking a crowd costs more than honestly joining it.
